caption: The drawing depicts a folding wooden object, likely a camp or deck chair frame, rendered in shades of red and brown. The object consists of two curved, elongated wooden legs on each side, connected at both ends and across the middle by straight slats and screws, with the main long pieces joined by metal hardware at pivot points. The wood grain and various screw heads are visible, with the chair drawn at an angle, showing a three-quarters perspective. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular border, and the artist’s name, "Magnus S. Fossum," is inscribed at the bottom left corner.
title: Child's Folding Chair
